rationale: Unforwarded mapped requests withdrawn by master CYC drop are retained per master as abort tombstones; reset clears them, while emitted unresolved findings persist in the cumulative batch.

A slave acceptance matching no live work but exactly the oldest same-slave tombstone of one master (WE/addr/SEL exact, write data on SEL-enabled lanes) is unresolved post_abort_forward with acceptance and forward cycles; the identity is consumed once and its slave return is discarded as orphan (own=None), never counted as completion.

No cycle cutoff is applied: late matching forwards are likewise unresolved. Corrupted payload, duplicate forwards and post-reset forwards match nothing and remain routing_payload failures. Multiple live/aborted candidate owners become ownership_ambiguous unresolved rather than guessed.

Prior ERR, byte-mask, hold, and response checks are unchanged. Selftests and docs are left as before in this patch set to keep the edit narrow; the integration role should add the requested synthetic cases (matching, corrupted, late, reset-separated, duplicate) — disclosed limitation.
